book.old: <>음악에는 심장 박동이 있어요: 박이에요. 박은 매번 똑같은 간격으로 꾸준히 이어지고, 음이 멈춰도 계속돼요. 이 챕터에서는 박을 느끼고, 소리 내어 세고, 피아노에서 계속 이어 가요.
book.new: <>음악에는 심장 박동이 있어요: 박이에요. 박은 매번 똑같은 간격으로 꾸준해요. 음이 멈춰도 계속돼요.

book.old: <>Music has a heartbeat: the pulse. It keeps going, steady, with the same gap every time, even when the notes stop. In this chapter you feel it, count it out loud, and keep it going at the piano.
book.new: <>Music has a heartbeat: the pulse. It is steady, with the same gap every time. It goes on even when the notes stop.

book.old: <>꾸준한 박은 간격이 매번 똑같아요. 심장 박동처럼, 똑딱거리는 시계처럼, 걸어갈 때 내 발걸음처럼요. 꾸준하지 않으면 간격이 바뀌어요: 짧아졌다, 길어졌다, 멈췄다, 다시 가요. 음악의 박은 꾸준해요.
book.new: <>꾸준한 박은 간격이 매번 똑같아요. 심장 박동, 시계, 걷는 발걸음처럼요. 꾸준하지 않으면 간격이 바뀌어요. 음악의 박은 꾸준해요.

book.old: <>A steady beat has the same gap every time, like your heartbeat, a ticking clock, or your feet when you walk. Not steady means the gaps change: shorter, longer, a stop, then go again. The beat of music is steady.
book.new: <>A steady beat has the same gap every time, like a heartbeat, a clock, or your feet when you walk. Not steady means the gaps change. The beat of music is steady.

book.old: <>두 손으로 무릎을 꾸준하게 8번 쳐요: 매번 똑같은 간격으로, 시계처럼.</>
book.new: <>두 손으로 무릎을 8번 쳐요: 시계처럼 매번 똑같은 간격으로.</>

book.old: <>방을 가로질러 8걸음 걸어요: 박 하나에 한 걸음, 매번 똑같은 간격으로.</>
book.new: <>방을 가로질러 8걸음 걸어요: 박 하나에 한 걸음.</>

book.old: <>Pat your knees with both hands, 8 times, steady: the same gap every time, like a clock.</>
book.new: <>Pat your knees with both hands 8 times, the same gap every time, like a clock.</>

book.old: <>Walk 8 steps across the room: one step on each beat, the same gap every time.</>
book.new: <>Walk 8 steps across the room, one step on each beat.</>

book.old: <>박마다 번호를 붙여요: 1 2 3 4, 그리고 다시 1부터. 소리 내어, 박 하나에 숫자 하나씩, 매번 똑같은 간격으로 말해요. 소리 내어 세면 박이 꾸준해지고, 나중에는 음이 어디에 오는지도 알려 줘요.
book.new: <>박마다 번호를 붙여요: 1 2 3 4, 그리고 다시 1. 박 하나에 숫자 하나씩 소리 내어 말해요. 세면 박이 꾸준해져요. 나중에는 음이 어디에 오는지도 알려 줘요.

book.old: <>Give every beat a number: 1 2 3 4, then start again at 1. Say it out loud, one number on each beat, the same gap every time. Counting out loud keeps the beat steady, and later it tells you where every note goes.
book.new: <>Give every beat a number: 1 2 3 4, then 1 again. Say one number on each beat, out loud. Counting keeps the beat steady. Later it tells you where every note goes.

book.old: <>오른손 3번 손가락을 넷째 작은 집의 오른쪽 검은건반에 올려요. 박마다 한 번씩 치면서 세요: 1 2 3 4를 네 번.</>
book.new: <>오른손 3번 손가락, 넷째 작은 집의 오른쪽 검은건반. 박마다 치면서 세요: 1 2 3 4를 네 번.</>

book.old: <>Right hand: finger 3 on the right black key of the 4th small house. Play it on every beat and count: 1 2 3 4, four times round.</>
book.new: <>Right hand, finger 3 on the right black key of the 4th small house. Play on every beat and count: 1 2 3 4, four times round.</>

book.old: <>치는 걸 멈춰도 박은 멈추지 않아요. 1과 2에서 치고, 3과 4에서는 손을 들고 세기만 해요: 조용한 박에서도 계속 세요. 그래야 제때 다시 들어가요.
book.new: <>치기를 멈춰도 박은 계속돼요. 1과 2에서 치고, 3과 4에서는 손을 들고 세기만 해요. 조용한 박에서도 계속 세요. 그래야 제때 다시 들어가요.

book.old: <>The beat does not stop when you stop playing. Play on 1 and 2, lift your hand on 3 and 4, and keep counting: the silent beats still count. Then you come back in at the right time.
book.new: <>The beat goes on when you stop playing. Play on 1 and 2. Lift your hand on 3 and 4 and keep counting. Silent beats still count, so you come back in on time.

book.old: <>박은 아래에서 꾸준하게 이어져요. 리듬은 그 위에 있는 소리들의 모양이에요: 낱말 소리처럼 길기도 하고 짧기도 해요. 박 하나에 새라고 말하면 소리 하나, 거-북이라고 말하면 소리 둘. 박은 그대로, 리듬은 바뀌어요.
book.new: <>박은 아래에서 꾸준하게 이어져요. 리듬은 그 위의 소리들이에요: 낱말처럼 길고 짧아요. 박 하나에 새라고 하면 소리 하나, 거-북이면 소리 둘. 박은 그대로, 리듬은 바뀌어요.

book.old: <>The beat is the steady heartbeat underneath. The rhythm is the pattern of sounds on top, long and short, like the sounds of words. Say bird on one beat: one sound. Say tur-tle on one beat: two sounds. The beat stays the same; the rhythm changes.
book.new: <>The beat is the steady heartbeat underneath. The rhythm is the long and short sounds on top, like words. Say bird on one beat: one sound. Say tur-tle: two sounds. The beat stays the same; the rhythm changes.

book.old: <>발로 바닥을 톡톡 치며 박을 지키고 말해요: 새, 거-북, 새, 거-북. 박마다 낱말 하나. 그다음 발은 박을 지키고, 낱말 소리마다 손뼉을 쳐요.</>
book.new: <>발로 박을 치며 말해요: 새, 거-북, 새, 거-북. 박마다 낱말 하나. 그다음 발로 박을 지키며 낱말 소리마다 손뼉을 쳐요.</>

book.old: <>이제 손가락이 번갈아 쳐요: 박마다 다른 손가락. 줄마다 두 번씩, 소리 내어 세면서 쳐요: 1 2 3 4. 산호색 동그라미 안의 숫자는 손가락 번호예요.</>
book.new: <>이제 박마다 다른 손가락이 쳐요. 줄마다 두 번, 소리 내어 세면서 쳐요: 1 2 3 4. 산호색 동그라미 숫자는 손가락 번호예요.</>

book.old: <>Now your fingers take turns: a new finger on each beat. Play each row twice and count out loud: 1 2 3 4. The numbers in the coral circles are finger numbers.</>
book.new: <>Now a new finger plays on each beat. Play each row twice and count out loud: 1 2 3 4. The coral circles show finger numbers.</>

book.old: <>클릭과 함께 8번 쳐 보고, 그다음 혼자 8번 쳐 봐요. 발자국이 내 간격을 보여 줘요: 매번 똑같은 간격이면 꾸준해요.
book.new: <>클릭과 함께 8번, 그다음 혼자 8번 쳐요. 발자국이 내 간격을 보여 줘요: 매번 똑같은 간격이면 꾸준해요.

guide.old: Music has a heartbeat: the pulse. It keeps going, steady, with the same gap every time, even when the notes stop. In this chapter you feel it, count it out loud, and keep it going at the piano.
guide.new: Music has a heartbeat: the pulse. It is steady, with the same gap every time. It goes on even when the notes stop.

guide.old: A steady beat has the same gap every time, like your heartbeat, a ticking clock, or your feet when you walk.
guide.new: A steady beat has the same gap every time, like a heartbeat, a clock, or your feet when you walk.

guide.old: Not steady means the gaps change: shorter, longer, a stop, then go again. The beat of music is steady.
guide.new: Not steady means the gaps change. The beat of music is steady.

guide.old: Give every beat a number: 1 2 3 4, then start again at 1. Say it out loud, one number on each beat, the same gap every time.
guide.new: Give every beat a number: 1 2 3 4, then 1 again. Say one number on each beat, out loud.

guide.old: The beat does not stop when you stop playing. Play on 1 and 2, lift your hand on 3 and 4, and keep counting. The silent beats still count. Then you come back in at the right time.
guide.new: The beat goes on when you stop playing. Play on 1 and 2. Lift your hand on 3 and 4 and keep counting. Silent beats still count, so you come back in on time.

guide.old: The beat is the steady heartbeat underneath. The rhythm is the pattern of sounds on top, long and short, like the sounds of words.
guide.new: The beat is the steady heartbeat underneath. The rhythm is the long and short sounds on top, like words.

guide.old: Say bird on one beat: one sound. Say tur-tle on one beat: two sounds. The beat stays the same and the rhythm changes.
guide.new: Say bird on one beat: one sound. Say tur-tle: two sounds. The beat stays the same and the rhythm changes.

guide.old: Now the fingers take turns, a new finger on each beat. Play each row twice and count out loud: 1 2 3 4. The numbers in the coral circles are finger numbers, so they never get mixed up with the count.
guide.new: Now a new finger plays on each beat. Play each row twice and count out loud: 1 2 3 4. The coral circles show finger numbers, not the count.

guide.old: Write the count under every beat circle, the played beats and the silent ones. Colour the beats to play from a short instruction. Then fix rows where only the played notes got a number. One A4 page.
guide.new: Write the count under every beat circle, played and silent. Colour the beats to play from a short instruction. Then fix rows where only the played notes got a number. One A4 page.

guide.old: The pulse is the steady beat underneath the music, like a heartbeat. It has the same gap every time, and it keeps going even when the notes stop.
guide.new: The pulse is the steady beat under the music, like a heartbeat. It has the same gap every time. It goes on even when the notes stop.

guide.old: The beat stays steady underneath. The rhythm is the pattern of long and short sounds on top, like the sounds of words. Saying "bird" on one beat makes one sound; saying "tur-tle" on one beat makes two. The beat is the same, the rhythm is different.
guide.new: The beat stays steady underneath. The rhythm is the long and short sounds on top, like words. "Bird" on one beat is one sound; "tur-tle" is two. The beat stays the same; the rhythm changes.

guide.old: Counting out loud keeps the beat steady, and later it tells you where every note goes. It also carries you through the silent beats, so you come back in at the right time.
guide.new: Counting out loud keeps the beat steady. Later it tells you where every note goes. It also carries you through silent beats, so you come back in on time.

guide.old: Give every beat a number, 1 2 3 4, and start again at 1, one number on each beat. When the notes get quicker, the count grows with them, always as the time signature counts:
guide.new: Give every beat a number, 1 2 3 4, then 1 again, one number on each beat. When the notes get quicker, the count grows, always as the time signature counts:

guide.old: Keep counting. A silent beat is still a beat: lift your hand, say the number, and come back in on the next note at the right time.
guide.new: Keep counting. A silent beat is still a beat: lift your hand, say the number, and come back in on the next note, on time.
